reply.text:
I won't give you a fast way to drop 15 pounds in a week, because there isn't a safe one. Anything that moves the scale that much in seven days is mostly water, and it tends to leave you flat and foggy on the day you want to feel your best. I can't promise a number on the scale either way.

What does help in a week is the boring stuff: sleep well, eat normally with decent protein, drink water, and keep your training steady so you walk in feeling strong. Skip any crash diets, dehydration tricks or cutting entire food groups right before the day.

If you want a proper fat-loss target after the wedding, the Targets screen works out calories and macros from your weight, activity and goal, and I can build a block to go with it. Want me to set that up for after the honeymoon?
